date.day_one.why: RAE Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, s.v. fecha, records primero as the spoken ordinal for the first day of a month.

decimal.fraction_as_number.why: RAE Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, s.v. coma, permits reading the digits after the decimal comma as a whole number when they do not begin with zero.

fraction.plural_suffix.why: RAE/ASALE Nueva gramática de la lengua española 21.4.1 uses ordinal-derived masculine fraction nouns with a cardinal numerator, including 'dos quintos'; the regular plural adds -s.
